description.value:
“The dead cities are not silent. They are mid-sentence.”

Ruin-Sense. When you spend 10 minutes examining a broken or ruined object, you can ask the GM one of: What was its last use? Who broke it? What does it still want? The answer is at least one truth.

Scavenger’s Eye (1/a Soma Break). Spend 10 minutes searching a rubble pile, gutted building, or wreckage of any kind. You recover one minor useful item — the GM picks from a short list of plausible salvage (a half-charged battery, a length of usable wire, a sealed container of clean water, a still-edible ration, a tool of one trade). It is what the place actually had.

Toxic-Lung Filters. You have reroll the lowest die on saves against airborne poisons, toxic gas, and rad-dust [TODO(adv-call)]. You can hold your breath for 10 minutes.
